summary: Phase 8 continuation dispatch: CLOSED the sole remaining blocker, `temporalTruthLemma_propositional_aux` in Cslib/Logics/Temporal/Tableau/Completeness.lean (90 build errors -> 0). Root-caused and fixed SIX distinct co-located defect classes in that one lemma, all pre-existing WIP bugs unrelated to G/H (zero allFuture/allPast references in this file): (1) the pre-cases `simp only [temporalApplyOne, ...] at hout` left `hout` frozen (un-iota-reduced) because it ran before `cases hφ'/hψ'` substituted concrete subformula shapes -- moved the unfold to ~35 per-leaf sites and additionally needed `Option.getD, reduceIte` (not just the originally-diagnosed lemma set) to fully collapse the nested if/match. (2) `Formula.complexity`'s R(phi,psi)/T(phi,psi) Lukasiewicz special-case match arms cannot resolve when an IsPropositional-bound subformula is still syntactically abstract and the sibling operand is literally `Formula.bot` -- added a new private helper `IsPropositional.complexity_imp_eq` (`cases hphi <;> cases hpsi <;> rfl`) and supplied it explicitly (with local ha/hc/IsPropositional.bot witnesses) at ~7 stuck omega sites; cases-ing the ambient hypothesis directly inside the nested `by`-block was tried and rejected (corrupts the outer term's later reference to the same hyp via metavariable capture). (3) ~56 sites had `ih`'s complexity-proof and IsPropositional-proof arguments swapped (`ih _ ha (by ...) t` instead of `ih _ (by ...) ha t`) -- fixed via a balanced-paren scan-and-swap script, with care to not corrupt the calls that were already correctly ordered (`ih (.atom p) (by ...) (.atom p) t`). (4) ~28 sites used bare `.atom` (0 args) as an IsPropositional proof term where `IsPropositional.atom` needs an explicit Atom argument -- supplied the matching bound name. (5) 10 sites did `cases hpsi' with | imp _ _ => ... hpsi' ...`, referencing hpsi' after cases destructed it -- named the arm (`| imp hpsic hpsid =>`) and reconstructed `IsPropositional.imp hpsic hpsid`. (6) 12 `obtain <ht_a, ht_c> := hout` sites mis-destructured a 3-part nested conjunction (List.forall_mem_cons on a 2-element list leaves a trailing `forall x in [], x in b`) as 2-part -- fixed with `obtain <ht_a, ht_c, -> := hout` and trimmed the now-unused List.forall_mem_nil/List.forall_mem_singleton/and_true simp args. Also fixed 3 sites using List.mem_singleton_self against a 2-element list (needed List.mem_cons_self instead, argument-free in this Lean/Std version, matching the same finding already recorded from this phase's earlier Rules.lean repair). Cleaned up in-dispatch (not deferred to P9): rewrapped ~53 lines that exceeded the 100-char style limit and added `omit [Hashable Atom] in` to the two lemmas flagged unused once the file compiled far enough to reach them. Final state: `lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Tableau.Completeness` -- 654/654 jobs, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Re-ran the full Phase 8 gate: `lake build Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Tableau.Defs Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Tableau.Soundness Cslib.Logics.Temporal.Tableau.Completeness` all GREEN together. Defs.lean and Rules.lean were NOT touched this dispatch (PM5 preserved-work bar honored -- verified via git diff --stat, only Completeness.lean and the plan file changed). Phase 8 flipped to [COMPLETED] in the plan.
